timeline.summary: Arihant Superstructures Limited’s Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of ₹0.25 per equity share on May 15, 2026.
Arihant Superstructures reported Q4 standalone revenue of ₹43.13 Cr, recommended a final dividend of ₹0.25 per share, and appointed Parth and Bhavik Chhajer as Joint MDs.
Arihant Superstructures Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings call for Q4FY26 and FY26 ended March 31, 2026, held on May 18, 2026, via the provided link.
Ashokkumar Chhajer and Bhanwarlal Chhajer, promoters, declared no encumbrance on their shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Arihant Superstructures hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 18, 2026, reporting ₹551 Cr annual revenue and ₹977 Cr pre-sales.
Arihant Superstructures received an exchange clarification request regarding Q4FY26 financial results on May 25, 2026.
Arihant Superstructures redeemed ₹70 Cr NCDs and secured release of mortgage on project land parcels.
